review_candidates.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. Background/IRC Summary The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world’s worst humanitarian crises and helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their lives. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities which support them, as well as those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 25 U.S. cities, we improve outcomes in the areas of health, safety, economic wellbeing, education and power. The IT department provides end-to-end technology solutions for the organization, including Application Development, Integration and Management, Enterprise Architecture, User Experience, Quality Assurance & Testing, and overall Product Management. While this role sits within IT, its focus is on partnering with the Measurement, Evaluation, Technology, Accountability, and Learning (METAL) Unit — bringing IT's systems and development expertise to METAL's technology and data priorities. The METAL Unit supports Crisis Response, Recovery & Development (CRRD) in building a culture of strong data and evidence use through stewardship of the Data & Performance Ecosystem, and coordinates the piloting and uptake of innovative technology solutions across four pillars: Global METAL Practice, Technology for Programs, Regional METAL Support, and CRRD Data & Analytics. This role is anchored in Technology for Programs which maintains the tools and systems that support program teams' data collection and use in the field. Job Overview/Summary Focused on data collection and program administration technology support, the Software Developer Analyst is a member of the team responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting IRC’s global Data Toolkits and the analysis of the data generated by these products. This includes CommCare, Microsoft Power BI, and Microsoft SQL Server Azure based data warehouse. Working in partnership with staff at various levels and locations, the Software Developer Analyst performs a key role in analyzing, developing, and improving tools and processes contributing to the successful rollout of the Data Toolkits products. Specific tasks include data platform development, support, configuration, technical assistance and issues routing, second line help desk support, and participation in setting standards for processes, data quality, security, and systems configurations. Major Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain Data Toolkits in CommCare Design and build PowerBI Dashboards linked to live CommCare data Review and analyze software requirements, confirm the feasibility and complexity of these requirements, and convert them into estimated developer tasks, validating that each requirement traces cleanly to system design and existing configuration before work begins Provide updates and technology insights/clarifications to the relevant stakeholders Develop and maintain data and metadata definitions, documentation and versioning. Create technical documentation including system diagrams and implementation manuals Implement and maintain data quality processes and development standards Ensure compliance with IRC’s data protection, confidentiality, and security policies Provide Tier-2 and Tier-3 support emerging from Countries and Regional Technology support team for the measurement technology products rolled out. During piloting and rollout, provide training and hyper-support on measurement technology products in close collaboration with the regional technology teams. Any other duties as assigned by the supervisor. Key Working Relationships Position Reports to: Business Systems Analyst Direct Reports: None Management in Partnership: None Key Internal Relationships CommCare Product Manager METAL QA Analyst IT Data Team Required Skills Three to six years of experience working in technology domain to develop and rollout data or technology platforms for programs – out of which, at least three years of experience developing, implementing, and supporting CommCare development for large and complex programs. Experience in source code and version control platforms, for example, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or similar. Strong in team development processes including pair programming, shadow sessions, code reviews and other strategies to ensure high-quality programing. Strong code quality assurance practices including unit testing, integration testing, as well as regression testing to ensure quality of the code getting shipped into production. Working knowledge of agile software delivery practices (user stories, backlog grooming, sprint ceremonies) and a demonstrated preference for iterative, requirements-driven development. Ability to effectively communicate in English both in verbal (i.e., day-to-day discussions, team meetings) and written (requirements and design specifications) form, as well as an overall ability to be clear and concise in all communications. More specifically, the ability to clearly explain complex technology issues in layman’s terms and simplify tech-related language depending on the audience/stakeholders is a huge asset. Strong attention to detail to ensure fidelity to requirements and high-quality products. Strong analytic curiosity and innovative problem-solving skills using a system thinking approach. Demonstrable ability to work both independently and in a dynamic, cross-functional team structure. Demonstrable ability to establish and maintain working relationships across all departments and levels of the organization. Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related discipline Experience with Databricks, Dataverse connectors, APIs, and Microsoft Azure This is a remote position open to internal candidates based in countries where IRC operates who have the right to work in their location. Successful candidates will be hired on a local employment contract and according to local salary scale. This role is open to candidates located and with the right to work in United Kingdom and Kenya. Compensation: (UK Pay Rate: £49,598 - £60,040/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements. Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.
